workouts.title: Aerobic Marathon Pacing Matrix [Set 1]
workouts.summary: Procedurally generated strategic running session targeting the Marathon distance. Helps build speed, neuromuscular pathways, and aerobic capacity.
workouts.riskReason: Dynamic cardiovascular stimulus managed with scheduled recovery bounds.

warmup.name: Aerobic Warm-up Segment
warmup.description: Easy jog for general temperature elevation and nervous system prep.
notes: Steady easy breathing and loose neck/shoulder musculature.

mainSet.name: Marathon Main Interval Reps
mainSet.description: Run repetitions of speed intervals focused on Marathon race specific pacing.
notes: Keep speed consistent
Relax posture between intervals.

cooldown.name: Marathon Recovery Cooldown
cooldown.description: Light jog to ease cardiovascular curves gently.
notes: Let heart rate subside
Focus on stretching calves and glutes.

easier.description: Reduce main set intervals count by 1 repetition to reduce overall volume accumulation.

mainSet.name: Easier Set
notes: Reduce speed slightly if feeling stiff

harder.description: Add 1-2 main set interval repetitions or decrease the rest gap by 15s.

mainSet.name: Harder Set
notes: Focus on maintaining race mechanics when fatigued.

coachingNotes: Complete a full dynamic warmup first.
Slightly lean forward into the speed segments.
Avoid overstriding at high velocities.
commonMistakes: Starting too quickly on early repetitions.
Truncating cooldown periods.
safetyNotes: Discontinue training if sharp muscle stress develops.
Stay fully hydrated throughout and post training.
